Wedding vendors, restaurants, shops, temples, associations and services across Long Island. Basic listings are free. We'll confirm your details with you before anything goes live.

What happens next

  1. We read every request and reply by email, usually within a few days.
  2. We confirm your details with you and check them against your website or Google Maps.
  3. Your free listing goes live, and you can update it any time.
